proposal: No compressor. Below 45 barg the control system transfers automatically to LDO (ER-03.10); availability loss is limited to the transfer. Option price for a booster compressor on request.
question: The GT requires at least 43.5 barg at the fuel skid inlet at base load; with about 1.5 bar loss in the gas receiving station we need 45 barg at TP-G1. ALP-OWN-FUL-001 allows 40 barg for up to 72 h/year. Is a gas booster compressor expected, or may the plant transfer to LDO / reduce load during these periods?
response: Not accepted as proposed. Operating on LDO between 40 and 45 barg would consume the 500 h/year permit allowance and costs about three times more than gas. The Owner cannot obtain a higher minimum pressure from the network operator. Please submit an option price and schedule impact for a gas booster compressor, and your estimate of the annual hours below 45 barg.
subject: Exceptional minimum gas pressure 40 barg is below the gas turbine requirement
